aboutMe.shortDescription: I build beautiful, responsive and user-friendly web applications.
aboutMe.description: Hello! I am a passionate aspiring Software Engineer with a deep interest in building scalable, efficient, and user-centric applications. Over the past couple of years, I have honed my skills in web development, creating intuitive digital experiences.
aboutMe.background: I started my coding journey during my undergraduate studies, where I discovered my love for problem-solving and algorithms. Since then, I've expanded my knowledge across the full stack, working with modern JavaScript frameworks, backend technologies, and databases.
aboutMe.careerGoals: My goal is to join a forward-thinking engineering team where I can contribute to impactful projects, continue learning best practices, and eventually take on leadership roles in software architecture.
aboutMe.interests: Beyond coding, I enjoy reading tech blogs, contributing to open-source projects, and exploring the latest trends in UI/UX design.
